objective.desired_outcome: Maximize the credible speed to multimillionaire-level liquid or transferable founder wealth in the 2026 economy, without a fabricated deadline or guarantee, using AI automation to cap cash downside while preserving majority-owned nonlinear upside.
objective.horizon: Open-ended; optimize time to first paid signal, repeatable owner-independent revenue, and transferable equity rather than a fixed $2 million/36-month headline.
controllable_success_measures: Reject candidates before build when exact incumbents, access restrictions, or target-scale support physics fail.
Require buyer-originated exact-gap evidence and paid behavior before treating any candidate as selected.
Keep exploratory demonstrations synthetic, read-only, reversible, and inside the frozen time/cash gates.
Separate cash/skill evidence, paid willingness-to-pay evidence, repeated-bottleneck evidence, and transferable-equity evidence.
Proceed autonomously through internal research, construction, and verification; pause only for external sending, publication, account/terms acceptance, purchase, or live-system testing.

risk_limits: No private customer data or restricted credentials during exploratory demonstrations
No external send, publication, purchase, or terms acceptance without approval
No candidate may rely on owner-dependent fulfillment at target scale
No debt, leverage, production penetration testing, unauthorized access, regulated/personal customer data, or uncapped liability
No claim that a synthetic artifact, bounty listing, prospect list, or first payment validates a wealth strategy
permissions: Internal economic modeling and red-team review
non_goals: Treating a synthetic demo as demand validation
Optimizing for a $2 million headline exit without owner-independent profit
Weakening a gate to keep a familiar candidate alive
Treating bounty/hourly income as the transferable wealth asset
Building generic evaluation software before repeated paid buyer evidence

experiments.hypothesis: At least two independent multi-client operators within one ecosystem identify the same monthly recurring exception and at least one economic signal.
experiments.alternative: No exact repeated outcome with an economic signal appears, so no product advances from these strata.
experiments.design: One plain-text, noncommercial research question sent individually to 12 audited organization-level routes; no links, tracking, call request, private data request, or follow-up to nonresponders.
experiments.target_population: Eight QuickBooks and four HubSpot multi-client operators from two previously audited public-source universes.
interpretation_rules: Zero substantive replies stops generic organization-channel discovery for these strata but does not prove absence of pain.
One substantive reply or divergent replies advances no product.
Two independent same-ecosystem exact-outcome replies plus one economic signal advance only that outcome to a 30-artifact evidence and incumbent screen.
Any paid-diagnostic request requires new approval before scope, price, data, or terms discussion.
experiments.result: Superseded before sending by EXP-002 after the user corrected the objective and a more specific paid diagnostic survived independent comparison.

experiments.hypothesis: At least one qualified U.S. operator of a consequential tool-using AI agent will prepay or fund escrow for a fixed $600 recorded-trace structural pilot that fits eight fulfillment hours.
experiments.alternative: Zero frozen-cohort payments, insufficient lawful-looking delivery, or an over-eight-hour accepted rehearsal stops this direct offer without weakening the thresholds.
experiments.design: After an accepted independent foreign-schema rehearsal and a frozen 30-row U.S. route cohort, send one individualized plain-text commercial message and at most one follow-up per organization. No links, tracking, first-message attachment, production access, penetration testing, personal/regulated data, or semantic/compliance claim.
experiments.target_population: Thirty U.S.-jurisdiction companies publicly operating consequential tool-using agents, with official action evidence, named decision-maker, and a general/founder business route whose stated purpose is compatible with a proposal.
interpretation_rules: The denominator freezes at 30 before send; bounces remain in it and confirmed delivery is reported separately.
One cleared $600 payment is a first paid signal only, not market or wealth validation.
Zero payments within 21 days and 12 acquisition hours stops the direct offer; fewer than 24 confirmed deliveries also marks the channel inconclusive/failed without replacement rows.

Productization remains prohibited until two unrelated buyers pay for materially the same check, logged reusable-core work reaches 60%, and one buyer purchases again or funds a binding recurring order.
Every accepted fulfillment must fit eight founder-active hours and the executed data/IP/liability boundary.
experiments.result: Internal technical rehearsal and exact 30-company cohort prerequisites passed. No market action, reply, payment, or delivery has occurred.

decisions.reason: The user explicitly corrected the objective. A fixed paper-exit target had distorted selection toward unsupported valuation math rather than paid proof, owner independence, and transferable equity.

decisions.decision: Select STR-005 for one bounded paid-signal experiment and do not pursue the Atlassian operator-to-own route in parallel.
decisions.reason: STR-005 has an owned working proof, current problem evidence, and a direct falsifiable payment gate. The Atlassian screen had zero qualified targets and no verified seller consent, receipts, code/IP rights, or bounded transfer economics.

decisions.decision: Reject foreign rehearsal packets v1 and v2 before payment or oracle access and require a complete buyer-declared v3 contract.
decisions.reason: V1 lacked human approval and recorded read-call evidence. V2 lacked buyer-declared absolute budgets and an immutable external-action argument contract. Inferring either would create a false PASS and misrepresent the service.

decisions.decision: Do not request send approval until the foreign-schema rehearsal passes, the commercial packet is internally cleared, and exactly 30 U.S.-jurisdiction recipients satisfy the frozen evidence and route-purpose screen.
decisions.reason: Only 7 of the initial 30 rows cleared the strict recipient screen. Weakening jurisdiction or route-purpose requirements would contaminate the payment experiment and raise avoidable compliance and reputation risk.

decisions.decision: Mark foreign rehearsal v3 as failed for fulfillment readiness and keep external outreach blocked.
decisions.reason: The frozen contract and baseline passed and the candidate was correctly rejected without evidence repair, but the pre-oracle diagnostic found only two of four seeded defects. Precision was 1.0; recall was 0.5. Complete delivery claims therefore remain unsupported.

decisions.decision: Accept the clean-sheet v4 foreign-schema rehearsal as satisfying the internal controlled-rehearsal prerequisite for EXP-002.
decisions.reason: The contract was frozen before candidate access, the candidate remained structurally valid, the pre-oracle advisory BLOCK was independently reproduced, and the later oracle comparison found all seven seeded root causes with zero false positives or misses. This does not erase the v3 failure or establish production accuracy.

decisions.decision: Freeze the exact 30-company recipient denominator and move EXP-002 to the external approval boundary without sending anything.
decisions.reason: The cohort now contains 30 non-duplicate rows that passed the same public action, U.S.-nexus, decision-maker, route-purpose, non-vendor, and inference-label gates. The remaining blockers are sender/legal fields, live preflight, exact individualized copy, and the user's explicit authorization.
